test_title: PYST 38: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 28 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Do you know the purpose of a fire extinguisher? It helps to __put up with__ an engulfing fire, in case of an emergency.
solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. put out .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"put up with"** means to tolerate something unpleasant, which is incorrect in this context.
 
• The sentence refers to the purpose of a fire extinguisher, which is to **extinguish or put out** a fire in an emergency.
 
• The correct phrasal verb to use here is **"put out,"** which means to extinguish something such as a fire, light, or cigarette.

Correct sentence: *Do you know the purpose of a fire extinguisher? It helps to **put out** an engulfing fire, in case of an emergency*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Common uses of phrasal verbs:**
 
 
• **Put up with:** To tolerate or endure something unpleasant. Example: "I can't put up with this noise anymore."
 
• **Run away with:** To escape with something. Example: "The thief ran away with the jewels."
 
• **Turn over:** To flip or rotate something. Example: "Please turn over the page."
 
• **Stand out:** To be noticeable or prominent. Example: "Her dress made her stand out in the crowd."
